run_peract_agent_evaluation: run the per-skill manipulation evaluation script using PerActAgent with a specified task ID
run_peract_with_test_pick: run the peract agent evaluation script with test pick mode enabled for grasping tasks
run_peract_dry_run: run the peract agent evaluation in dry run mode without executing real robot actions
run_peract_with_object: run the peract agent evaluation script targeting a specific object like cup or bowl
run_peract_with_cat_map: run the peract agent evaluation with a custom category map JSON file for object detection
